overview: Combine Isle is the last major surface outpost of the Combine Empire on Luclin. Its arcane observatories and research stations remain active, though weakened.
history: The Combine Empire established the Isle as a research hub centuries before the collapse.
Arcane observatories monitored planar activity across Luclin.
Teleportation ruins linked the Isle to Sanctus Seru and Katta Castellum.
After the Combine collapse, mariner clans and scholars maintained the remaining structures.
Siren Courts began raiding the Isle for arcane relics.
hooks: Siren raiders attempt to seize an arcane vault.
An elemental anomaly destabilizes the teleportation ruins.
Mariner clans request help defending trade posts.
